title: Fourier Entropy-Influence Conjecture
exact_target: Is the entropy of every Boolean function's squared Fourier coefficients controlled by a universal constant times its total influence?

sources.citation: Maria Jose Gonzalez, Paul MacManus, Maria Cristina Pereyra, "Further evidence towards the Fourier Entropy-Influence conjecture," arXiv:2606.00246 (June 2026).
